summary: Phase-3 backend + frontend end-to-end testing complete. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS (100%) covering dungeon/item seed integrity, team-size + duplicate + cross-guild validation on POST /expeditions, full 60s lifecycle with backend formula verification (team_power & success_chance), lazy completion sweep, success-path rewards (+35 gold, +25 xp), idempotency (gold unchanged on second fetch), loot upsert into inventory, cross-guild expedition 404, item monetization validator (3 cases), and multi-level resolve_levelup (Mage 350 XP → level 3 + intellect +2). Frontend: verified end-to-end on /dungeons → /dungeons/goblin-warrens/start (3 select-adventurer testids found) → /expeditions/{id} report → /expeditions list (countdown + refresh) → /inventory (empty state). Mobile 375x812 confirmed no horizontal overflow on /dungeons, /expeditions, /inventory. All required data-testid attributes present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1393 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold by 2x. Recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, guilds.py, recruitment.py, expeditions.py, seeds.py, helpers.py) before Phase 4 to keep maintainable.

_complete_one_expedition uses an atomic find_one_and_update claim via {status:'in_progress'} → {status:'completing'} — correct idempotency design. Concurrent callers correctly short-circuit (`if not claimed: return`). Verified empirically: two sequential GETs after completes_at returned identical gold/xp values.
Lazy sweep is triggered from THREE endpoints (/guilds/me, /expeditions, /expeditions/{id}) — efficient and consistent.

validate_item_monetization correctly rejects: real-money + non-cosmetic, real-money + affects_combat, real-money + affects_economy, real-money + affects_ranking. Accepts pure cosmetic. Called inside seed_dungeons_and_items so any future bad seed is rejected at startup.

_resolve_levelup uses a while-loop and class-keyed stat picker — multi-level XP overflow handled correctly (tested with Mage 350 XP → +2 intellect, level 1→3). Threshold formula uses old_level (`adv['level'] * XP_THRESHOLD_PER_LEVEL`).
compute_team_power role bonus: +5 each for Tank/Healer/DPS + extra +10 for all-3 roles → max +25 role bonus. Matches spec exactly.
Cross-guild isolation correctly returns 404 (not 403) on GET /expeditions/{other_user_exp_id}, preventing existence-leak (line 999-1001).
Inventory upsert uses ($inc quantity + $setOnInsert id+guild+item+acquired_at) with unique (guild_id, item_id) index — guarantees never-duplicate rows on multiple loot drops.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — recommend migrating to lifespan handler. Non-blocking.

Frontend report-narrative, report-loot-grid, and report-no-loot only render on completed expeditions (not in_progress). This is correct behavior since result_log is only populated after lazy sweep finalizes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Phase-3 testids + flows verified on desktop & mobile)

test_credentials: Phase-3 tests use freshly registered users (p3_*@orbus.test, p3ui_*@orbus.test, p3ui2_*@orbus.test) for full isolation. Pre-seeded tester@orbus.test / password123 still works.
seed_data_creation: Created ~10 fresh users + guilds via /api/auth/register + /api/guilds. Each test guild has 3 recruited adventurers. Backend seed of 1 dungeon (goblin-warrens) + 5 items is idempotent and runs on every startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1+2+3 all green. Pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_phase3_test.py runs in ~70s (60s wall-clock for the lifecycle test; tests use pytest-xdist for parallelism). Failure-path branch was NOT deterministically observed because recommended_power=45 with 3 lvl-1 adventurers gives ~95% success — the spec's note about this limitation is accepted. To force failure, you'd need to artificially craft a low-power team (e.g., 1-stat adventurers) which the API doesn't currently allow. Loot drops are 50% per success — observed at least one drop across runs. Level-up multi-loop verified via direct call to _resolve_levelup() helper.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Phase 3 backend implementation is correct: atomic expedition claim prevents double-completion, lazy sweep is idempotent, item monetization validator enforces real-money/cosmetic invariant, level-up loop handles multi-level XP overflow, cross-guild isolation uses 404 (not 403) to prevent existence leak.
